components.name: SN65HVD78D 3.3 V RS-485/RS-422 transceiver
components.function: Differential line transceiver for NMEA 0183 (RS-422) receive/transmit electrical layer

keyParameters.esd: >15 kV HBM, >12 kV IEC 61000-4-2 contact, >4 kV IEC 61000-4-4

components.notes: NMEA 0183 is an opto-isolated current-loop/RS-422 interface at 4800 baud; a bare transceiver alone does NOT provide the required galvanic isolation. An isolator (e.g. CMP-N183-02) or isolated transceiver plus isolated DC-DC is required; compatibility is a TEST_REQUIRED item, not TESTED.
